notes: Reviewed against CashModuleSetters.sol, CashModuleStorageContract, EnumerableAddressWhitelistLib, ArrayDeDupLib and solady EnumerableSetLib (same project as c00574). CashLendLib's loops (_unwindLendCollateral, hasOpenBorrows, sourceWithdrawal) are in an external library reached by DELEGATECALL and not part of this bytecode. All 29 ABI functions were read by structure (the largest is 472 lines). Loops counted: configureModulesCanRequestWithdraw's and setSafeTier's loops, _checkBalance, _hasNonZeroAmount, _areAssetsWithdrawable, _processWithdrawal, checkDuplicates outer and inner, EnumerableAddressWhitelistLib.configure, solady values(), and the spending-limit renewal while (2498, from a library not listed in the pack) - all shown as while; the mapping of some inlined copies to their source loop was done by shape only. P1: ERC-7201 slot constants and day factorisations (46 lines). No execution run.
summary: Faithful on the paths read with the loops present, but it shares c00574's defects: the namespaced per-safe mapping and solady sets print as phantom slot-0 and Vyper-style variables, whitelist loops are rotated around their zero-address guard, and free-pointer memory hides custom-error reverts.
